name: ABE Ultra Hybrid MAX
rules: Never describe an unavailable model as executed.
Do not renormalize missing-model weights and call it the full five-model ensemble.
Only use completed draws preceding each prediction and separate first and second zone.
Adjust weights using strictly earlier prequential results, with shrinkage to initial weights.
If 20-draw features are insufficient to fit a neural model, skip it and report that fact.
Compare with matched random baselines before making predictive claims.
No evidence that this configuration improves fair lottery odds.
